text:
ravi: Planning maintenance for edge compute rack `edge-gpu-3` next Thurs 23:00 UTC (2h window). Purpose: NVMe controller firmware update on compute hosts + rolling live-migrate of running GPU pods. Expected: short scheduling hiccups and a handful of pod live-migration retries. No full GPU reboots planned unless forced.

ravi: High level: cohorts of 6 hosts, stagger 10m. Live-migrate running pods off host, apply nvme fw, remount, run health checks, then allow scheduler to resettle. We'll enable backfill buffer and prewarm images.

anna: Which pools affected? Are dedicated/reserved pools included?

ravi: Scope: edge ephemeral + preemptible pools in APAC-edge only. Dedicated/reserved pools excluded. We'll tag ticket with `dedicated-safe` and `edge-only`.

brandt: Recommend cohort size 5 and 12m stagger to give more time for live-migration under load. Also add `image-prepull` and `kv-cache-preseed` after each host returns.

mira: Ops runbook note: make sure the live-migrate tool flags pods with gpu-memory > 12GB to prefer graceful drain windows; lower-memory pods can be evicted quicker. Abort if >3% pod restart rate or scheduling p95 > 2s for 10m.

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-4012 created and scheduled. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/edge-firmware-migration. Pager: eng-infra-oncall.

tom: Support: We'll post status page 6h pre-alert to APAC edge customers and prepare PSAT for live migration noise. Also prepare an enterprise note for customers with pinned placement.

brandt: Cost note: if backfill spills to other regions, estimate small cross-region egress for control-plane RPCs ~5k calls and potential short term extra spot usage. Tag cost impact.

ravi: Runbook snippet:
```
edge-cordon --rack edge-gpu-3 --cohort 5 --stagger 720
edge-live-migrate --grace 180 --gpu-threshold 12288
nvme-fw-update --slot auto
edge-healthcheck --checks disk,iops,driver
image-prepull --timeout 300
kv-cache-seed --delay 600
```

mira: I'll run a preflight tomorrow to validate live-migrate under 75% load. If that passes, we proceed. I'll post preflight results in this thread 2h before.

anna: ACK (ops). I'll make sure scheduling automation has extra backfill buffer and that Dedicated routing remains pinned.

tom: ACK (support). Drafted comms and PSAT.

ravi: OK. Marking scheduled pending preflight. Will update ticket and ping here with final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
